summary.text: Julie Dahlberg is the Republican candidate for the Texas State Senate, District 21, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Judith Zaffirini.
She is a U.S. Army veteran and nonprofit and communications consultant who was also the Republican nominee for the seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Julie Dahlberg was born in Kentucky and served in the U.S. Army from 1993 to 1994.

Her career experience includes working as a nonprofit and communications consultant, and she has been affiliated with the Faith Based Security Network, the Wilson County Republican Party and Guadalupe County Republican Women.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has been a full-time volunteer at her church, FBC Sutherland Springs, and is a founding director of a San Antonio youth development nonprofit, and founded a charitable ministry, The Garden, in 2024.

She also said she has held volunteer leadership roles in county Republican organizations since 2019, served as a delegate to the Texas Republican convention, and managed two other state legislative campaigns.
Dahlberg won the March 1, 2022 Republican primary for Texas Senate District 21 and lost the November 8, 2022 general election to incumbent Judith Zaffirini.
She again advanced from the Republican primary for the seat on March 3, 2026.
In her 2026 survey, she listed citizen-led governance, servant leadership and term limits among her key messages.
